CustomField.description: The ROLE responsible for this group - Danish, CFO, Legal, FES, Accounting, Prop. Mgmt. - mirroring Task_Group_Def__mdt.Owner_Label__c. THIS IS NOT A USER AND NOT A RECORD OWNER. A master-detail child has no OwnerId at all, and the value here has always been a role string in this model. Naming follows the _Label__c type-suffix discipline for Text carrying a human label. Never pair this with a completion date and render it as completed by role - that is a lie the current model already carries warnings about.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The role accountable for this group of items, for example CFO or Legal. It is a label, not a Salesforce user.
CustomField.label: Owner Label
